During the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]] in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] '''refugee freighter''' attempted to escape the besieged [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and was attacked by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]]. When the [[Kyp's Dozen]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Veema]] tried to destroy the freighter's pursuers, she lost control of her [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] due to a hit and crashed into the freighter, killing the occupants of both vessels.
